annotation.bound_parties_text: The White Paper is a policy consultation document setting out options and binds no one; it invites Member States, institutions and stakeholders to comment.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The purpose of this White Paper is to set out policy options on how to achieve these objectives.
annotation.dates_quote: The consultation is open for comments until 19 May 2020.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: WHITE PAPER On Artificial Intelligence - A European approach to excellence and trust
